thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()

for i in range(count):
    with urllib.request.urlopen('"'"'http://127.0.0.1:%d/%d'"'"'%(server.server_port,i),timeout=10) as response:

python3 -c 'import hashlib,http.server,json,pathlib,threading,time,urllib.request
count=8; size=65536; delay=0.06
articles=[('"'"'research-document-7101-%d: '"'"'%i+'"'"'x '"'"'*(size//2)).encode()[:size] for i in range(count)]

python3 -c 'import hashlib,http.server,json,pathlib,threading,time,urllib.request
count=8; size=65536; delay=0.06
articles=[('"'"'research-document-7102-%d: '"'"'%i+'"'"'x '"'"'*(size//2)).encode()[:size] for i in range(count)]
class Source(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        time.sleep(delay); value=articles[int(self.path[1:])%count]
        self.send_response(200);self.send_header('"'"'Content-Length'"'"',str(len(value)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(value)
    def log_message(self,*args): pass
server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('"'"'127.0.0.1'"'"',0),Source)
thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
started=time.perf_counter();h=hashlib.sha256();total=0
for i in range(count):
    with urllib.request.urlopen('"'"'http://127.0.0.1:%d/%d'"'"'%(server.server_port,i),timeout=10) as response:
        value=response.read();h.update(value);total+=len(value)
server.shutdown();server.server_close()
result=dict(kind='"'"'actor-local-controlled-http-research'"'"',documents=count,read_bytes=total,fixture_service_delay_seconds=delay,wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started,sha256=h.hexdigest())
pathlib.Path('"'"'research-7102.json'"'"').write_text(json.dumps(result));print(json.dumps(result))
'

python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,time
p=pathlib.Path('"'"'batch-7102'"'"');p.mkdir(exist_ok=True);start=time.perf_counter();digest=hashlib.sha256()
for i in range(16):
    value=hashlib.sha256(('"'"'7102:'"'"'+str(i)).encode()).digest()*(32768//32)
    with (p/str(i)).open('"'"'wb'"'"') as f:f.write(value);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
for f in sorted(p.iterdir()):digest.update(f.read_bytes())
print(json.dumps(dict(kind='"'"'durable-file-batch'"'"',files=16,bytes=32768*16,sha256=digest.hexdigest(),wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-start)))
'

python3 -c 'import hashlib,http.server,json,pathlib,threading,time,urllib.request
count=8; size=65536; delay=0.06
articles=[('"'"'research-document-7102-%d: '"'"'%i+'"'"'x '"'"'*(size//2)).encode()[:size] for i in range(count)]
class Source(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        time.sleep(delay); value=articles[int(self.path[1:])%count]
        self.send_response(200);self.send_header('"'"'Content-Length'"'"',str(len(value)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(value)
    def log_message(self,*args): pass
server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('"'"'127.0.0.1'"'"',0),Source)
thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
started=time.perf_counter();h=hashlib.sha256();total=0
for i in range(count):
    with urllib.request.urlopen('"'"'http://127.0.0.1:%d/%d'"'"'%(server.server_port,i),timeout=10) as response:
        value=response.read();h.update(value);total+=len(value)
server.shutdown();server.server_close()
result=dict(kind='"'"'actor-local-controlled-http-research'"'"',documents=count,read_bytes=total,fixture_service_delay_seconds=delay,wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started,sha256=h.hexdigest())
pathlib.Path('"'"'research-7102.json'"'"').write_text(json.dumps(result));print(json.dumps(result))
'

python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,time
p=pathlib.Path('"'"'batch-7102'"'"');p.mkdir(exist_ok=True);start=time.perf_counter();digest=hashlib.sha256()
for i in range(16):
    value=hashlib.sha256(('"'"'7102:'"'"'+str(i)).encode()).digest()*(32768//32)
    with (p/str(i)).open('"'"'wb'"'"') as f:f.write(value);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
for f in sorted(p.iterdir()):digest.update(f.read_bytes())
print(json.dumps(dict(kind='"'"'durable-file-batch'"'"',files=16,bytes=32768*16,sha256=digest.hexdigest(),wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-start)))
'

python3 -c 'import hashlib,http.server,json,pathlib,threading,time,urllib.request
count=8; size=65536; delay=0.06
articles=[('"'"'research-document-7102-%d: '"'"'%i+'"'"'x '"'"'*(size//2)).encode()[:size] for i in range(count)]
class Source(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        time.sleep(delay); value=articles[int(self.path[1:])%count]
        self.send_response(200);self.send_header('"'"'Content-Length'"'"',str(len(value)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(value)
    def log_message(self,*args): pass
server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('"'"'127.0.0.1'"'"',0),Source)
thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
started=time.perf_counter();h=hashlib.sha256();total=0
for i in range(count):
    with urllib.request.urlopen('"'"'http://127.0.0.1:%d/%d'"'"'%(server.server_port,i),timeout=10) as response:
        value=response.read();h.update(value);total+=len(value)
server.shutdown();server.server_close()
result=dict(kind='"'"'actor-local-controlled-http-research'"'"',documents=count,read_bytes=total,fixture_service_delay_seconds=delay,wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started,sha256=h.hexdigest())
pathlib.Path('"'"'research-7102.json'"'"').write_text(json.dumps(result));print(json.dumps(result))
'

python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,time
p=pathlib.Path('"'"'batch-7102'"'"');p.mkdir(exist_ok=True);start=time.perf_counter();digest=hashlib.sha256()
for i in range(16):
    value=hashlib.sha256(('"'"'7102:'"'"'+str(i)).encode()).digest()*(32768//32)
    with (p/str(i)).open('"'"'wb'"'"') as f:f.write(value);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
for f in sorted(p.iterdir()):digest.update(f.read_bytes())
print(json.dumps(dict(kind='"'"'durable-file-batch'"'"',files=16,bytes=32768*16,sha256=digest.hexdigest(),wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-start)))
'

thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()

for i in range(count):
    with urllib.request.urlopen('"'"'http://127.0.0.1:%d/%d'"'"'%(server.server_port,i),timeout=10) as response:
